recipes.name: Preview export
recipes.summary: Export a flattened PNG or JPG preview from the working copy only.

recipes.name: Color separations
steps: Stamp visible on a copied document.
Hide the VINTONE group and work on the stamped layer.
Remove the background with anti-alias off and contiguous off.
Cut each ink color to a named layer.
Do black first if misregistration will be applied.
Group separation layers and convert the group to a smart object.
Save layered PSD or TIFF output to an approved destination.

recipes.name: Vintage misregistration
recipes.summary: On the black separation, add a color-overlay tint and a small white inner shadow offset.

recipes.name: Garment mockup
recipes.summary: Place preview art into a layered tee mockup design group and export a review image.

edgeCases: Gradients and low-opacity dither should remain the same screen, not become extra ink colors.
Output paths must be approved before writing files.
Never save separation output over the licensed source template or sample file.
